idea-plugin.name: HappyHorse by Ace Data Cloud
idea-plugin.description:
HappyHorse video generation and task lookup, provided by Ace Data Cloud.

Install this independent integration, open Settings → Tools → HappyHorse MCP, enter an application API key, list models, choose one explicitly and submit a prompt. Use the returned task ID to check the same task until a terminal result. Generation uses your Ace balance; installation does not include free API usage.

The native service panel works without AI Assistant. Optional MCP setup also connects these tools to AI Assistant; it does not add an LLM provider preset.

This is an independent Ace Data Cloud integration, not an official HappyHorse or JetBrains product. Models, access and current pricing are controlled by your Ace account.

Service documentation · Current pricing

Get your Ace Data Cloud API key

Sign in to Applications and open General Application. If it is missing, select Initialize General Application. Click the copy button marked 1 beside API KEY.

Store the raw key in your client’s credential store or in the environment variable shown below. Add Bearer only when setting an HTTP Authorization header yourself. Check access to the required operations, the current pricing, and the application balance. To use a separate key for this integration, open Manage Keys to set Allowed APIs, expiration, and usage limit.
